data.content_ref: inline:The temporal-ordering invariant shared by SRC_001 and SRC_004 reduces to a single abstract mechanism: a synchronous precondition that must fire before provider invocation. The shared mechanism abstracts both the typed lease-mismatch code and the endpoint drift field into a unified pre-call barrier. It is refuted if the two foundations can be satisfied by a test suite where the precondition check executes concurrently or after the provider call, or if a minimal frozen lease cannot represent both drift-field mutation and typed-exception mutation without rebuilding the routing topology.
